topic: Photograph the Thanksgiving grocery receipts from several family members and have AI total who paid what and work out the fewest payments to settle up
text:
Splitting today's Thanksgiving groceries with family? Photograph each receipt and add them in ChatGPT with the plus button, along with this:

Total what each person paid from these receipts: [whose receipt is whose]. Split it [evenly / by household] and list the fewest payments that settle everyone up.

Check the totals against the paper before anyone sends money. Who usually holds the receipts in your family?
